evidence.quote: In the spirit of stimulating your research appetite, I'd like to mention some topics that have captured my attention recently.
I have been monitoring the financial stability implications of the potential lower desirability of U.S. financial assets in flight-to-safety events.
I have been keenly interested, for some time now, in how stresses in the commercial real estate (CRE) sector could potentially spill over to the rest of the U.S. economy.
